oracle.reason: Scale benchmark over external real-text corpus files (100K passages, ~103 MB of vectors) - not an in-program synthetic task a J twin can replay. Exactness is refereed in-program on every trial by a full brute-force scan of the same working array; the canonical receipt output carries the per-trial exact verdicts and top-10 indices.
oracle.note: exemption declared at cut time and recorded permanently; this receipt was NOT refereed by a J twin
